name: AgentX
description: AgentX is a benchmark for evaluating autonomous agent behaviour and instruction following across interactive/sequential tasks. It measures agents' ability to plan, act, and achieve goals in simulated or structured environments using automated evaluation of task completion. The suite targets decision-making, robustness, and instruction adherence across diverse scenarios.
reputation: A community-hosted benchmark on Hugging Face with growing interest for agent evaluations but not yet widely standardized as a de facto leader.
